blocks.text: The URL is the only durable search state. SearchQuery is what it parses into, ResultsState is what the results unit holds for the current queryId, and PriceQuote carries the currency and the fetch time so a stale price is never shown as current.

blocks.title: What stays in the units and what never persists
blocks.text: Uncommitted guest counts and dates stay inside the inputs unit, so a half-typed date never refetches. Prices render with their quoted time and are never written to storage, so a reopened tab refetches.
